description: Ask Verse's "swaps" skill (Words and the world), one of the proven skills with the most evidence that Verse offers over MCP (read-only): rated proven on a-to-mind.com from evidence (real asks in Verse's benchmark, its tests), never from how it describes itself. Asks like "what can i swap for buttermilk", "substitute for eggs in baking", "baking powder substitute". The skill's own code answers it on the server, the same code that draws its card on a-to-mind.com (no model), with the sources its card cites; an ask the skill does not take is refused, not guessed. Times are worked out on the server's clock (UTC). The card itself is at the "open" link in the result.

ask.description: The ask in plain words (3 to 600 characters), e.g. "what can i swap for buttermilk".

response_type.description: What to get back: 'text' (default) or 'raw_data' (the structured result as JSON). 'image' is not offered yet.
